notice_policy: All packaged license texts retained; selected_terms records choices. Retaining unused alternative texts does not select them. Relevant source notice blocks collected conservatively, including test/platform sources.

toolchain_library.scope: Rust standard-library notices for static Rust library code, separate from Cargo registry components. Release-wide notices are retained conservatively; their presence does not assert that every architecture-specific component is linked. This segment does not cover OS or native system libraries.
toolchain_library.additional_terms: Retain complete COPYRIGHT-library.html exceptions, including Unicode-3.0, Zlib, and BSD-2-Clause AND selected MIT. Select MIT wherever that notice offers MIT as an alternative; other stated terms remain as recorded. No LGPL alternative selected solely by presence in preserved HTML.
toolchain_library.source_evidence: Rust 1.95.0 release and exact compiler commit identified in build evidence. The original library notice is preserved byte-for-byte; root MIT and Apache license texts come from the same official Rust commit.

status: Distributable notice candidate; inclusion in the final image or archive has not been verified.
scope: 145 Cargo registry components plus a separately identified Rust 1.95.0 standard-library notice segment; conservative source and binary attribution collection.
graph_evidence: Package identities and feature selections correspond to the dependency metadata fingerprint recorded here. The metadata document itself is not included.

archive_and_source_integrity.scope: Exact locked registry archive comparison and Rust standard-library notice reconciliation; not final artifact inclusion or OS/native coverage.
archive_and_source_integrity.source_notice_presentation_normalization: CRLF to LF and whitespace at excerpt boundaries only; exact internal source text and full original source hashes verified. Excerpt order may differ from source order.

source_notice_format: Packaged license/notice bytes copied unchanged. Source excerpts preserve exact internal comment text; CRLF is normalized to LF and whitespace may be trimmed only at excerpt boundaries. Excerpt order may differ from source order. Source hashes identify original full bytes and line ranges identify each excerpt.
